nodes.description: Ponzi public state variable holding the Ponzi contract interface reference at fixed address 0xEB82...853B
mapping(address => uint256) public lastTime tracking the last timestamp each address claimed yield
private mapping(address => uint256) _balances of ERC20 token balances
PonziYield.yield() public function that mints payout based on deposit and elapsed timestamp
PonziYield constructor(uint256 initialSupply) that mints the initial supply to msg.sender
ERC20._mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal function increasing total supply and balances
msg.sender used to index lastTime and query ponzi.players
block.timestamp used for cooldown check and payout computation
Unchecked multiplication deposit * (block.timestamp - regTime) producing payout
Write lastTime[msg.sender] = block.timestamp derived from block.timestamp cooldown logic
local uint payout computed from deposit and elapsed time
local uint deposit returned by ponzi.players for the caller
local uint regTime returned by ponzi.players for the caller
local uint id returned by ponzi.players, unused in computation
_mint parameter address account receiving minted tokens
_mint parameter uint256 amount of tokens to mint

edges.reason: msg.sender indexes lastTime when writing block.timestamp, allowing any caller to set their own cooldown entry
block.timestamp is written directly into lastTime[msg.sender], creating timestamp dependence in yield throttling
block.timestamp drives the 24 hour cooldown require check in yield
msg.sender is the actor performing yield and is passed downstream
block.timestamp minus regTime is a factor in the unchecked payout multiplication
deposit read from the external Ponzi contract feeds the unchecked payout multiplication
regTime read from the external Ponzi contract feeds the unchecked payout multiplication
result of the unchecked multiplication is assigned to the payout local variable
overflowed payout value flows into _mint as the minted amount
yield makes an external call ponzi.players(msg.sender) to the referenced Ponzi contract
account parameter determines the mint recipient in _mint
amount parameter determines the minted quantity in _mint
initialSupply constructor parameter is minted to msg.sender via _mint

normalization_plan.reason: payout is purely a temporary holder consumed as the amount argument of _mint
deposit is only used as an operand of the unchecked payout multiplication
regTime is only used as an operand of the unchecked payout multiplication
id is destructured from ponzi.players but never used, so it folds into the yield routine
initialSupply is the sole argument consumed by the constructor mint
account is a direct argument of the _mint operation
amount is a direct argument of the _mint operation
